info.title: OpenVPN Docker Management API
info.description: Authenticated REST API for frontend management of clients, runtime state, diagnostics, and declarative configuration. Except for health and documentation, send the API key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Process health, build metadata, and instance diagnostics.

tags.name: Clients
tags.description: Client credentials, profiles, IPv4 intent, and active sessions.

tags.name: Runtime
tags.description: OpenVPN daemon status and structured event history.

get.description: Unauthenticated liveness check. It does not report OpenVPN or storage health.
Returns the state summary plus an issues array when diagnostic issues exist.

get.summary: List active, revoked, and deleted clients

delete.description: Requires an empty body. The immutable client UUID tombstone remains in authoritative state.

get.description: The response contains a private key and must be handled as a credential.

put.description: Use auto or dynamic without address. Use static with an address from the configured static region.

delete.summary: Release a revoked client's retained IPv4
delete.description: Requires an empty body and is valid only for a revoked client with a retained assignment.

post.description: Requires an empty body. A client with no active session returns 200 with was_connected=false.

get.summary: Read OpenVPN runtime status and sessions
Read desired configuration and CAS digest

put.description: Send the previous desired digest as a quoted If-Match value and the complete normalized configuration as the body.

post.summary: Apply the current desired configuration online
post.description: Use desired_digest from GET/PUT desired and current_revision from GET plan. The API remains available while OpenVPN and the broker restart.

bearerAuth.description: API key created locally with `ovpn api key create`.

ClientID.name: client_id
ClientID.description: Complete canonical immutable client UUID; names and UUID prefixes are rejected.

EventLines.name: lines
EventLines.description: Number of most recent events. Defaults to 100.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exactly one quoted lowercase SHA-256 digest from the previous desired response ETag.

RequestID.description: UUID used to correlate the request with server logs.

ETag.description: Quoted desired configuration SHA-256 digest for If-Match.

ContentDisposition.description: Attachment filename derived from the client name.

StateDoctorResponse.description: Detailed instance diagnostics. `issues` is omitted when empty.

ClientMutationResponse.description: Committed client mutation. Runtime convergence is reported separately when required.

AddressMutationResponse.description: Committed address mutation and per-client runtime outcomes.

DisconnectResponse.description: Disconnect outcome, including successful no-op when no session exists.

ApplyConfigurationResponse.description: Apply transaction and runtime activation outcome.

BadRequest.description: Malformed path, query, header, media type, body, or JSON.

Unauthorized.description: Bearer API key is missing, malformed, unknown, or deleted.

error.message: API key is missing or invalid

NotFound.description: Resource or client does not exist.

MethodNotAllowed.description: HTTP method is not accepted; inspect the Allow header.

Conflict.description: Digest, revision, state, uniqueness, lock, or recovery conflict.

error.message: configuration state changed or is busy

UnprocessableEntity.description: JSON is valid but violates client, IPv4, or configuration semantics.

error.message: client request is not valid for the current state

InternalError.description: Unclassified internal failure with no implementation details exposed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Authentication storage, PKI, OpenVPN, broker, supervisor, or another required dependency is unavailable.

ipv4.description: auto, dynamic, or a valid static IPv4 address.

release_ipv4.description: true releases the assignment; false retains it for later release or reissue.

ipv4.description: auto, dynamic, or a valid static IPv4 address.

address.description: Required only for static mode and forbidden for auto/dynamic.

force.description: Bypasses only confirmed health-preflight warnings; never bypasses schema, CAS, lock, or recovery checks.
